result_preview.description: This agent monitors employee performance ratings and tenure milestones, then automatically generates and routes compensation adjustment proposals for manager review and approval. It ensures consistent application of compensation policies across the organization, reduces manual processing overhead, and maintains audit trails for compliance. The agent integrates with payroll cycles to implement approved adjustments on schedule.

Synchronizes workforce compensation records with established pay structures and reconciles adjustments across employee populations.
